text.text_excerpt: Those fishbooooowwwllllssss . I don't know what's in it but I know for $10 I'm set for the remainder of the day! There are two locations on bourbon st and you can't go wrong with either one. FDD was the first place I wanted to go to once I was settled into my hotel. A young lady assisted me at the counter and gave me my official welcome into the city and the French quarter. If you're a person that likes a sweet cocktail and that mirrors the alcohol well then the fishbowl is what you want, but be WARNED, it can and WILL sneak up on so regardless if you're a light weight or you can throw some shots back with the best this fishbowl will have you floating around bourbon, canal, by the river, ...

Hands down the best deal on Bourbon! Fais Deaux Deaux is a cart in an alley next to a bar. $10 for a hurricane fishbowl. Get you pretty buzzed/tipsy after only one fish bowl. It has Everclear after all. And if you're not buzzed after one fishbowl? $5 gets you a refill. Will definitely be getting another fishbowl when I'm back in New Orleans.

Ok so I saw people walking around with the big bowl so I had to ask where they got it from and they pointed us in the right direction. I was told about the price $10 and figured it would be watered down but at least I'd have a cool drink to walk around with. Let me tell you I was wrong, the drink is a hurricane (signature drink if N.O.) and it was great..very strong and we'll worth the price... definitely my first choice next time I return.
